description: Ecoshape and public flood-defence partners provide airborne LiDAR DTM elevation measurements over the entire Hondsbossche Dunes project area. The native research objective is studying morphological development. Nine acquisition dates span May 2015 through March 2018. Coverage: 2015-05-24, 2015-12-28, 2016-05-04, 2016-09-01, 2016-12-05, 2017-04-19, 2017-08-11, 2017-12-06, 2018-03-19. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: Raw format, vertical datum, point density and accuracy are unstated beyond native MIME descriptors. The observations are distinct from compiled area and transect representations. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Hondsbossche collection identifies these dune systems as primary flood defence created with sand nourishment. Simulation use concerns their monitored geometry and morphological development.
